ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels in the central peduncle and fluke junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the majority of both lobes. A central black vertical column extends from the peduncle into the center of the fluke, terminating in a small dark wedge. Low-intensity dark mottling is concentrated at the proximal base of the left lobe where it meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle; pixel depth is minimal relative to the vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge presents a macroscopically smooth linear boundary with low-amplitude pixel irregularities; specific serration frequency is obscured by image grain.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetric upward sweep with concave trailing edges and convex lateral tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive jagged interface pattern between the black central pigmentation and the white lobe surfaces, characterized by irregular pixel clusters at the boundary.
